title: A supposed removal service belongs to the abuser
mechanism_summary: An enforcement complaint describes a site publishing intimate images without consent. It then directed targets to apparently separate paid removal services controlled by the same operator.
suggested_beats: An abusive image is posted.
A supposed outside service demands a removal fee.
Seek independent reporting and removal support.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone desperate to remove an intimate image
why_it_works: False separation hides the financial incentive behind the abuse.

title: A paid helper threatens a young person's future
mechanism_summary: An official warning describes a company approached by a young sextortion target. It used threats about education and family employment to solicit repeated assistance payments.
suggested_beats: A frightened person asks for help.
The helper adds frightening payment pressure.
Contact independent victim-support services.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: a young person seeking urgent sextortion help
why_it_works: Desperation can make an exploitative helper seem indispensable.

title: A helper discourages the family from reporting
mechanism_summary: An official warning describes a representative offering to locate a sextortionist for a fee. The representative discouraged a parent from contacting law enforcement.
suggested_beats: A family receives an assistance offer.
Payment is requested while reporting is discouraged.
Verify help independently.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: a parent trying to protect a targeted child
why_it_works: Concern for a child can make unsolicited rescue promises persuasive.

title: A hacked inbox supplies material for blackmail
mechanism_summary: A sentencing account describes phishing used to obtain email access and private images. The attacker then threatened disclosure to force further compliance.
suggested_beats: A deceptive message obtains account access.
Stolen intimate material becomes a threat.
Secure the account and report the coercion.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone whose private account is compromised
why_it_works: Stolen material gives an attacker leverage without any consensual exchange.

title: Blackmail demands recordings of other people
mechanism_summary: A sentencing account describes an attacker threatening to expose stolen intimate images. The attacker demanded additional recordings involving other people.
suggested_beats: An attacker holds private imagery.
The demand expands to violating others' privacy.
Seek help instead of complying.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone pressured with stolen intimate material
why_it_works: Exposure threats can be used to push a target into further harm.

title: A dating conversation becomes an exposure demand
mechanism_summary: An advisory describes a dating contact moving the conversation to another platform. After obtaining intimate material, the contact demands money to keep it from family and friends.
suggested_beats: A new match requests a private chat.
Intimacy abruptly becomes blackmail.
Stop contact and seek reporting support.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone meeting a new dating contact
why_it_works: A sudden threat exploits trust formed during apparent mutual interest.

title: A gaming friendship becomes financial blackmail
mechanism_summary: An apparent gaming friend requests intimate images. An official example describes the contact then demanding money for silence.
suggested_beats: A gamer meets an apparent friend.
An image request becomes a money demand.
Tell a trusted adult and report the account.
why_it_works: Shared interests can make an unfamiliar contact seem safe.

title: An email bluffs about an intimate recording
mechanism_summary: A consumer warning describes emails demanding cryptocurrency to keep embarrassing material secret. The sender's claim of possessing a recording is a bluff, not evidence of access.
suggested_beats: An alarming email alleges surveillance.
The sender demands payment for silence.
Do not pay a threat unsupported by evidence.
who_falls_for_it_archetype: someone frightened by an unsolicited exposure threat
why_it_works: Shame and uncertainty can make an unsupported claim feel credible.
